# Sign cross-check against fitted weights

<!-- Generated by `npm run data:build`. Do not edit. -->

Creamer, Leifer & Pillow fitted a linear dynamical model to whole-brain calcium imaging, constrained to a connectome mask, and released the fitted weights (MIT). Their sign is an independent view of each connection's effect. Wormlight never uses them as strengths. The comparison covers the 1049 of Cook's 3709 chemical connections that the table also lists; they lie among the head neurons the imaging recorded.

A disagreement is not an error in either source. The weights are coefficients of a linear model of calcium signals, fitted on a mask that joins chemical and gap-junction edges without telling them apart, with much of the nervous system unrecorded, so a weight can absorb effects that no single synapse carries. They are reported so that a surprising sign can be checked against the physiology.

## Agreement by sign source

| Sign source | Covered | Agree | Disagree | Unsigned here |
| ----------- | ------- | ----- | -------- | ------------- |
| physiology  | 0       | 0     | 0        | 0             |
| expression  | 467     | 247   | 220      | 0             |
| rule        | 384     | 240   | 144      | 0             |
| none        | 198     | 0     | 0        | 198           |
